high_level_goal.name: Ensure timely evaluation and decision-making on supplier proposals
high_level_goal.description: Provide administrators with tools to evaluate supplier proposals within defined timeframes, including automatic rejection for delays, to maintain operational efficiency and product quality.

low_level_goals.description: The administrator evaluates the proposal and assigns one of three statuses: accepted, revisions requested with a comment, or rejected.
